props.heading: Cookie policy
props.body:
Sample copy for demonstration. Requires review before production use.

Essential cookies

We use essential cookies for security, CMS sign-in sessions, and remembering basic preferences.

Analytics

First-party analytics events are recorded only when you consent, and are not used for cross-site advertising.

Managing cookies

You can clear cookies through your browser settings and decline analytics consent without losing access to the core website.
